verdict.rationale: GitHub documents a Copilot CLI (probe-4) and cloud-agent 'Automations' that run non-interactively on a schedule or in response to repo events (github-copilot-docs-15), which supports scripted/workflow-automation use. However, there's no explicit documentation of CLI flags, exit codes, or headless scripting examples confirming the interactive CLI can be invoked non-interactively in arbitrary scripts. Missing for 10: explicit CLI non-interactive/headless mode documentation, example CI/CD script usage, independent confirmation of scripted invocation working reliably.
